purpose: Single shared definition of the evidence supply chain. The JavaScript exporter reads it to classify availability and compute coverage; the Python reconciler reads it to prove its rule registry has not drifted from it. Changing a rule on one side without the other fails a test.

available.description: The evidence exists and was exported with provenance.

missing.description: The evidence should exist for this record's lifecycle stage and does not. A data gap.

not_applicable.description: The evidence cannot apply to this record. There is nothing to check, so the rule is satisfied rather than blocked.

not_yet_available.description: The record has not reached the lifecycle stage that produces this evidence. Expected to resolve with time, not with work.

blocked_by_integration.description: A named external or staged integration dependency prevents production. Never satisfied by fabricating provider evidence.

contradictory.description: Two authoritative sources disagree. Exported with both values so the disagreement is reviewable rather than silently resolved.

schema_drift.description: The source carries a schema or revision this exporter does not know. Never coerced into the current representation.

constraintClasses.engineering: No capture surface or schema exists yet; building one is in our control.
constraintClasses.integration: Blocked on an external provider or a staged program gate.
constraintClasses.business_policy: Blocked because nobody has declared the policy value the rule needs.

customerRequest.notes: Portal decision record written by the customer portal.

authorizedQuote.notes: Catalog identity stamped at pricing time by functions/pricingEngine.js.

acceptedSnapshot.notes: The signed snapshot lives on the acceptance receipt; the quote carries only totals and a digest. The exporter verifies the digest and reports disagreement as contradictory.

payments.notes: Legacy quotes without a ledger carry a derived deposit entry; provenance records the legacy path rather than claiming ledger evidence.

payouts.notes: No settlement store exists. The Connect program stops after Sandbox UAT, so no production payout evidence may be produced or simulated. See docs/STRIPE_CONNECT_PROGRAM.md.

processorFeeSchedule.notes: The settings field does not exist and no organization has declared a schedule. The exporter reads it if present and never infers one.

operationalPlan.notes: Projected the same way src/lib/beoPayload.js projects the BEO.

costBasis.notes: Staff-recorded cost evidence captured with the quote version.

actualConsumption.sourceField: verified complete category declarations and immutable actuals receipts
actualConsumption.notes: Operator-declared labor, purchasing, and other costs from the exact accepted source. All three categories must be explicitly complete or not applicable; missing values never become zero. This is recorded cost evidence, not attendance, payroll, payment, physical consumption, or event delivery proof.

overrunThresholds.notes: Explicit tolerances are exported only from the exact event workflow instance and its immutable tenant-published definition. Seed, absent, invalid and undeclared policy remain unavailable; values are never inferred. Actor and time come from the pinned publication.
